items.tldr: Anthropic tells IPO investors it did $16.8B in Q3 revenue — profitable on an adjusted basis
items.tldr_zh: Anthropic 向 IPO 投资人透露 Q3 收入 168 亿美元，调整后已盈利
items.take: A company that sells 'safe AI' is going public — when idealism starts answering to shareholders, can it still be idealism?
items.take_zh: 一家卖「安全 AI」的公司现在要上市了——当理想主义开始对股东负责，它还能是理想主义吗？

items.tldr: Bain flags a $4.2T/year revenue gap between AI infrastructure spending and actual returns
items.tldr_zh: 贝恩报告：AI 基建投入与实际创收之间存在每年 4.2 万亿美元的缺口
items.take: Built the highway, found there are no cars yet — is the $4.2T gap a timing problem, or a demand problem?
items.take_zh: 建了一座高速公路，发现车还没造出来——4.2 万亿的缺口，是还没找到用途，还是用途根本不存在？

items.tldr: Australian startup Apate runs thousands of AI agents posing as victims to engage scammers and extract their bank details
items.tldr_zh: 澳大利亚初创 Apate 用上千个 AI agent 冒充受害者，主动跟骗子聊天套出银行账户和钱包地址
items.take: Using AI to scam scammers — when 'benevolent deception' gets automated, does the moral line get clearer or blurrier?
items.take_zh: 用 AI 骗骗子——当「善意欺骗」被自动化，道德边界是变清楚了，还是变模糊了？
